title: LADM LA_GroupParty
description: A group of parties sharing a common interest in one or more basic administrative units (e.g. co-owners, a family group, an association, a consortium). LA_GroupParty extends LA_Party. Each member party may hold a different share of the group's collective interest.

allOf.$comment: INHERITANCE: Extends LA_Party (which itself extends VersionedObject)

groupType.description: LA_GroupPartyType codelist. Common values: familyGroup, association, consortium, baGroup (co-ownership without formal legal entity).

members.description: Member parties of this group with their respective shares [2..*]

GroupPartyMember.description: A party's membership in a group, including their fractional share of the collective interest

party.description: Typed reference to the member LA_Party

share.description: This member's fractional share of the group's collective interest (e.g. 1/3 for equal three-way co-ownership). Omit if shares are undivided.

shareCheck.description: Flag indicating the shares across all members have been verified to sum to 1
